channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: One Year With a Heatable Solar and Battery Setup: What He Would Change
item.dc:creator: Andrew Till / Mr. EV
item.description: A UK owner reviews a year with 30 Australian-built panels and 20 kWh of Alpha ESS storage, covering cold-weather shutdowns, tight winter capacity and the upgrades he wishes he had picked.

item.title: The Rivian R2 Through the Eyes of a Wheelchair User
item.dc:creator: JerryRigEverything
item.description: JerryRigEverything tests the smaller, cheaper Rivian R2 with Cambry, who drives using hand controls, covering transfers, wheelchair loading, car seats and the adaptive headlights.

item.title: How a Historic Dutch Fort Island Runs Without a Grid Connection
item.dc:creator: Foundation Zero
item.description: Pampus, a 19th-century fort near Amsterdam, runs on solar, wind, hydrogen and biogas with battery and seasonal heat storage, and asks visitors to use less power when the weather turns.

item.title: Geely's Solid-State Battery Reportedly Heads for Real-World Vehicle Testing
item.dc:creator: Ben Alexxander
item.description: A video breaks down reports that Geely is targeting a roughly 400 Wh/kg solid-state cell and plans to build a pack in 2026 to test inside an actual vehicle, not just in the lab.

item.title: Cybercab Specs Surface as Uber Stacks Up Robotaxi Partners
item.dc:creator: InsideEVs
item.description: An InsideEVs podcast digs into a reported EPA filing for Tesla's two-seat Cybercab and the wave of Uber deals with Lucid, Nuro, Stellantis, Wayve and others chasing Waymo.

item.title: Mercedes Built the VLE Around the Passenger, Not the Driver
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Mercedes' electric VLE puts rear-seat luxury first, with a 115 kWh battery, 800 volt charging and a quoted 435 mile range. UK pricing is not confirmed yet.

item.title: A Dutch Eco-Village Built From Old Tires Runs Mostly on Solar
item.dc:creator: DW Euromaxx
item.description: Aardehuis is 23 Earthships near Amsterdam made from recycled tires, timber and adobe, running largely on solar with a heat pump for the darkest winter days.

item.title: Honda's Super-N Is a Tiny City EV Built for Fun, Not Range
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: A widened kei-based Honda with a 29.6 kWh battery, recycled materials and a Boost button. The host calls it the cheap, characterful runabout the Honda E should have been.

item.title: How Uzbekistan Is Rebuilding Its Economy Around Renewables
item.dc:creator: Financial Times
item.description: An FT film tracks Uzbekistan's push into renewables, market reform and Gulf investment as gas runs short, demand climbs and the grid shows its age.

item.title: Electric Boats Are Having Their Early-Adopter Moment
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: An Out of Spec visit to an all-electric boat dealer in Virginia makes a blunt, honest case for matching electric boats to short trips and overnight charging.

item.title: CorPower's Wave Machines Aim for a 10x Jump in Efficiency
item.dc:creator: Europe's Foundry
item.description: A Stockholm developer says its C5 wave converters roughly halve cost and parts, rode out 20 meter waves off Portugal, and chase a tenfold gain in structural efficiency. Featured profile by Europe's Foundry.

item.title: Polestar 4 Drops $10,000 as the Discounts Pile Up
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: The camera-rearview, 100 kWh Polestar 4 beat its own range rating on a road trip, and a current $10,000 incentive softens a price the reviewer still calls steep.

item.title: The New Orbea Wild Wires Every Part Into One Battery
item.dc:creator: Rob Rides EMTB
item.description: Orbea's Avinox-powered Wild links motor, dropper, derailleur and an electronic Fox shock to a single battery, with an RS tune the reviewer says wakes the motor at low effort. Paid partnership noted.

item.title: A Full Off-Grid Solar Setup Runs About $28,000
item.dc:creator: The Solar Lab
item.description: The Solar Lab prices an off-grid system for an average US home near $28,000, with batteries alone close to $20,000, and explains why storage, not panels, drives the bill.

item.title: The Case That Solar and Batteries Now Undercut Gas
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: A news roundup gathers cited reports that solar plus storage match the cheapest new gas plants, Spain's drop to Europe's cheapest power, and a returning 2027 Chevy Bolt near $30,000.

item.title: A Year With McMurtry's Speirling, the Fan Car That Makes Its Own Grip
item.dc:creator: Chris Harris on Cars
item.description: Chris Harris spends a year with McMurtry's single-seat Speirling, an electric fan car he says makes its own grip. The maker quotes 1,000 hp, 1,000 kg and roughly 2,000 kg of downforce generated standing still.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
